page.title: Personas
page.purpose: See every identity this instance can act as, and how healthy each one is, so the right persona is chosen deliberately rather than by habit.

priorities.statement: Kind (personal versus business) is visible on every row, because choosing the wrong one is an error that surfaces only much later.
Health is shown per persona — a persona with an expiring document or a failing mailbox looks different from a healthy one.
Creation requires a declared legal basis; the form must make that a deliberate statement, not a field to skip.
Retired personas remain visible and clearly marked, because the journal still references them.

states.description: No personas yet. A single, well-explained creation path.
Personas load but health findings do not.
Creation was attempted without a legal basis or with a kind/identifier mismatch.
The list is cached during an outage; per-persona health is shown as unknown rather than healthy.
